windfield.label: Model forecast (Proposed)
windfield.model: Open-Meteo best_match: the best model Open-Meteo has for each node (the answer does not name it)

grid.order: row major from the south west corner: node = j * nx + i, i along longitude (east), j along latitude (north); node latitude = lat0 + j * dlat, node longitude = lon0 + i * dlon

windfield.convention: direction is where the wind comes FROM, degrees clockwise from north; u is toward the east and v toward the north: u = -speed * sin(direction), v = -speed * cos(direction); a wind from the north (0) has v negative, a wind from the east (90) has u negative; calm is a speed of 0 and gives u = 0 and v = 0; a speed with no direction gives null; u, v and gust are whole numbers in steps of 0.1 km/h (divide by 10 for km/h); a node or an hour with no reading is null, never 0
windfield.unit: km/h, whole numbers in steps of 0.1 (value x 10)
windfield.resolution: about 0.1 degree (about 10 km, the model resolution): 138 distinct model cells lie under the 150 nodes; a node is a model value, not a measurement, and nodes on one cell carry one wind
windfield.thinned: hours kept: every hour to 24 hours ahead, then every 3 hours (150 nodes by 49 hourly stamps is more than a 200 KB file can hold beside the eight points); the hours in between are to be interpolated in time; the stamps are not evenly spaced

tendency3h.note: the raw 3 hour change is mostly the daily pressure tide (about minus 2.5 hPa at 14:00 and plus 1.7 at 09:00); only the change beyond the tide means anything
the raw 3 hour change is mostly the daily pressure tide (about minus 2.5 hPa at 14:00 and plus 1.7 at 09:00); only the change beyond the tide means anything

OMSJ.name: Sharjah Intl
OMSJ.side: west coast (Sharjah, not Ras Al Khaimah)

tendency3h.note: the raw 3 hour change is mostly the daily pressure tide (about minus 2.5 hPa at 14:00 and plus 1.7 at 09:00); only the change beyond the tide means anything

stationsNote: the stations are airports, not the rain points; METAR wind is a 10 minute mean in whole knots, temperature and dew point are whole degrees, pressure is the QNH in whole hPa; a gust is in a report only when it passes the mean by 10 kt (0.1 to 0.7 percent of reports), so no gust means none reported, never calm; relative humidity is worked out from temperature and dew point (Magnus: RH = 100 * exp(17.625 * Td / (243.04 + Td)) / exp(17.625 * T / (243.04 + T)), Recomputed) and is good to a few points
comparisonNote: each point has the station nearest to it (nearestStation, with the distance); comparison is model minus observed at the hour of the latest report (Recomputed): temperature in deg C, relative humidity in %, wind (the 10 minute mean) and gust in km/h, pressure (QNH) in hPa; the observed gust is the peak of the report, the higher of the mean and a reported gust; the station is an airport, so a difference is partly place and height, not only model error

pressure.basis: Pressure fall level none. Forecast: the largest 24 hour change of pressure in the next 72 hours is -1.6 hPa at Showkah and Kadrah (2026-10-27 13:00 to 2026-10-28 13:00, median of 6 models). Observed: 24 hour change +2.0 hPa at OMRK; 3 hour change beyond the tide +0.7 hPa at OMRK (raw +2.0); 24 hour change +1.0 hPa at OMFJ; 3 hour change beyond the tide -0.3 hPa at OMFJ (raw +1.0); 24 hour change +2.0 hPa at OMSJ; 3 hour change beyond the tide +0.7 hPa at OMSJ (raw +2.0). A fall is a supporting reading: 85 to 88 percent of falls of 4 hPa in 24 hours are not followed by rain within 12 hours, so it raises attention and never sets a stage alone. No plan value exists for this parameter; the thresholds are Proposed (data/weather/params_calibration.json).

forecast.rule: pressure_msl, median of the usable models, 24 hour fall

dust.basis: Dust level watch. Forecast: CAMS dust reaches 363.0 ug/m3 at Al Munai on 2026-10-26 20:00; pm10 reaches 161.6 ug/m3 at Al Munai (Model forecast, Proposed; CAMS has a high background: median 36 to 43 ug/m3). Observed: no dust code and no low visibility without fog, mist or rain in the last 3 hours at OMRK, OMFJ, OMSJ. Weak: CAMS dust cannot separate the dust hours the airports reported from its own background (the alert level caught 3 of 10, 4 of 21 and 2 of 26 observed episodes since 2022, and about three in four alarms had no dust within 6 hours); the observed signals are better. No plan value exists for this parameter; the thresholds are Proposed (data/weather/params_calibration.json).

forecast.rule: CAMS dust at 10 m, and pm10 for the alert

observed.watch: a dust code (DU, BLDU, DRDU, DS, SS), or visibility under 5,000 m with no fog, mist or rain
observed.alert: a dust code with visibility under 3,000 m, or dust with a peak wind of 40 km/h or more at the same station

visibility.basis: Visibility level none. Observed: the lowest visibility in the last 3 hours is 6000 m at OMFJ (METAR visibility stops at 10 km: 10,000 m means 10 km or more). No forecast trigger: model visibility has no skill (best_match found 7 of 85 low visibility hours at OMRK in 92 days). The fog level of the engine is separate. No plan value exists; the thresholds are Proposed (data/weather/params_calibration.json).

observed.rule: METAR prevailing visibility, or any FG, BCFG, MIFG, PRFG

thresholds.forecast: none: model visibility has no skill and is shown, never used

levelsNote: read only: these levels do not change the weather stage, which stays rain and fog; unknown is never none; no plan value exists for any of them

check.rowsKey: ws, gust: [the point, the nearest node, node minus point] in km/h; dir: [the point, the node, the angle between them] in degrees; sameCell says whether both were served from one model cell
check.note: each plan point is compared with the grid node nearest to it; a node in the same model cell must agree with the point to the rounding (0.2 km/h, 1.5 deg); a node in the neighbouring cell is up to about 7 km away and differs by place, which is not scored

health.words: Conditions: forecast ok at 8 of 8 points, air quality ok at 8 of 8, wind field ok at 150 of 150 nodes, stations 3 of 3 fresh. Every parameter is read.

gaps.what: No gust is measured at site: a model gust is not a METAR gust and METAR carries a gust in 0.1 to 0.7 percent of reports
gaps.owner: Wet Utilities with NCM; a season of recorded forecasts closes it

gaps.what: No rain gauge register is on file
NCM automatic station observations (26 stations in the area, 15 minute data) sit behind a token page and are not read
Model visibility has no skill and is shown, never used for a level
Heat thresholds are Proposed from October to March only; summer heat belongs to the summer arrangements
The rain plan has no trigger for wind, gust, humidity, temperature, pressure or dust: the levels are read only inputs and are not plan content

notes: a missing reading is no reading: null in a value, None in an array, never 0 and never calm
the arrays of a point start at the current hour and hold 72 hours, one per hour, on Ras Al Khaimah time; a band is [lowest model, median of the models, highest model]
wind direction is the direction the wind comes from; calm is a speed of 0 with no direction, a variable wind has a speed and no direction
CAPE differs by a factor of 3 between models: it is shown per model (capeByModel) and never sets a level
the thresholds of the levels are Proposed from the scout of 24 Oct 2026 (data/weather/params_calibration.json); the rain plan has no trigger for these parameters
